column1: # Smoke-mode edits for the EPW Pb example: file, text to find, replacement (tab-separated).
# Phonon k-mesh 8x8x8 instead of 14x14x14; q-mesh 3x3x3 instead of 6x6x6; EPW fine q-mesh 8x8x8
# instead of 20x20x20. The fine k-mesh stays at 20x20x20: at 8x8x8 EPW finds no states at the
# Fermi level with this smearing and lambda divides by zero.
